llm_response.reason: The website https://www.northfaceoutletfactory.com/ exhibits several characteristics of a scam website. It has unusually low prices, claims to be an official outlet store without clear affiliation with the actual North Face brand, and lacks transparency in its contact information and privacy policy. The WHOIS information is also not publicly available, and the DNS records show an HINFO record with 'RFC8482', which may indicate an attempt to evade detection. Furthermore, the website's design and product offerings seem too good to be true, which is a common trait of fake online shopping scams. Therefore, based on these characteristics, it is likely that this website is a scam.
